question: ‘Oolong’ is a variant of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tea**__.

__
 
• **‘Oolong’ is a variant of Tea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Oolong **is a traditional Chinese tea.

 
 
• It is made from the leaves of the Camellia Sinensis plant.
 
• **Note**: The same plant is used to make Green tea and Black tea.
 
• The process of oxidation is what creates green, dark, and oolong tea.
 
• Oolong is created when leaves are wilted in the sun and slightly bruised to create partial oxidation.
